skins.title: SKINS
skins.text: Unlock a new look every 100 cleared shots. Skins are cosmetic and never change the odds.
fair.title: PROVABLY FAIR
fair.intro: Every shot is decided before you take it: HMAC_SHA256(server_seed, client_seed:nonce:shot). Bytes 0-3 → outcome, bytes 4-5 → wind. You see the SHA-256 of the server seed now and the seed itself when you rotate.
rules.title: HOW TO PLAY
rules.intro: Apple Shooter is a step crash game. Place a bet, then shoot arrows at the apple on your partner's head. Every cleared shot moves him further away and raises the multiplier. Cash out after any cleared shot — or keep shooting. A lethal shot ends the round and the bet is lost. Clear all {levels} shots to win the top multiplier automatically.
rules.step: Each shot: multiplier = previous × 1 / chance. Before the shot you see its exact chance and the multiplier you will reach.
rules.wind_text: The wind of every shot is part of its fair hash and is shown before you shoot. Stronger wind makes the shot harder and raises the step by the same factor, so the return does not change.
rules.helmet_text: From level {level} you can buy a helmet for the next shot. If that shot is lethal, the arrow bounces off: you keep {keep}% of your multiplier and shoot the same level again. Price = chance of a lethal shot × the value it saves (RTP {rtp}).
rules.helmet_limit: This casino allows {n} save(s) per round.
rules.helmet_off: The Steel Helmet is not offered by this casino.
rules.revenge_text: Lost on level {level} or higher? Start a new round within {sec} seconds with a bet no bigger than the lost one and the whole ladder is multiplied by ×{boost}.
rules.rtp_text: Theoretical RTP of the main bet: {rtp} for any cash-out strategy (multipliers are rounded to 0.01). Maximum win {max}× bet. Every shot is decided by HMAC-SHA256 of the server seed (its hash is shown before you play), your client seed, the round nonce and the shot number — see FAIR.
rules.cosmetic: Aiming is cosmetic. The pull and angle only change the animation; the outcome of each shot is fixed by the fair hash before you shoot.
rules.malfunction: Malfunction voids all pays and plays. An unfinished round is kept and restored the next time you open the game.
